subject: Information Theory
title: Criticisms of MaxEnt
description: A tiny lesson with a big payoff: Criticisms of MaxEnt.

hook.text: Maximum entropy sounds perfect—assume the least. But critics argue it secretly assumes more than it admits.

buildup.text: The choice of constraint set is itself an assumption. Different constraints yield wildly different distributions.

discovery.text: Seidenfeld showed that MaxEnt can violate Bayesian conditioning: updating and MaxEnt don't always agree.

twist.text: Defenders counter that every method makes assumptions. MaxEnt just makes them explicit and minimal.

climax.text: The debate is unsettled. MaxEnt is powerful but not universally accepted as the foundation of inference.

punchline.text: Even maximum ignorance requires choosing what to be ignorant about.

quiz.question: What is a main criticism of the maximum entropy principle?
options: The choice of constraints is itself a hidden assumption
